title: Pyrido-indole-one hybrids as potential anticancer agents against breast carcinoma: development of Ru(II)-catalyzed annulation of indole-2-carboxamides, biological screening and molecular docking studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35445-35459
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06548H, Paper

Mommuleti Pradeep Kumar, Tukki Sarkar, Vemavarapu Durga Prasad, Nidhi Sharma, Harish Kumar B., Andagulapati Sai Balaji, Bathini Nagendra Babu
Ru(II)-catalyzed synthesis of 1H-pyrido[3,4-b]indol-1-one hybrids via annulation of indole amides with ynones yielded compound 9c, showing selective cytotoxicity toward MDA-MB-231 cells and moderate EGFR affinity, indicating therapeutic promise.
